name: dof_fiscal_ratio_history
source: Department of Finance Canada -- Fiscal Monitor (multi-issue historical fetch)
units: pdc_ytd and rev_ytd in CAD millions; ratio_pct in percent
notes: Multi-year YTD summary built by walking historical Fiscal Monitor issues from FY2019-20 onward. Each row is one issue. pdc_ytd is stored as a positive number (absolute value of public debt charges YTD, which DoF reports as a cost). ratio_pct = pdc_ytd / rev_ytd * 100. Used by derive_fiscal_plate2_band() to compute the 5-year trailing same-month-of-year min/max envelope for Plate 2.
